## Topics
- Descriptive 'Table 1' with gtsummary
- Correlation (Pearson, Spearman)
- Two-sample and paired t-tests
- Chi-square test of independence
- Tidy test output with broom

## Learning objectives
By the end of this module you should be able to:

- Build a Table 1 stratified by a grouping variable
- Choose a test that matches the variable types
- Run and interpret cor.test(), t.test(), chisq.test()
- Report results in a sentence with estimate, CI, and p-value

## Data
NHANES: blood pressure by sex, smoking x diabetes, BMI vs. BP
